name: quioteframework/cloud-s3
description: Minimal AWS S3 REST client for Quiote, SigV4-signed get/put/delete/head/list against a single bucket, with no aws-sdk-php dependency, plus a signed-request method for operations it does not model itself. Shared by the S3 session and filesystem backends.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/cloud-s3/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
